title: L2.money
tagline: Track L2 usage, manage wallets, and make it easier to move funds between various L2s
description:
L2.money tracks Ethereum L2 usage and makes it easy to manage your L2 wallets

This project is still a work in progress, but once complete L2.money would let you do three main things:
- View global L2 usage statistics and data
- View your balances on various L2 platforms
- Deposit to, withdraw from, and and transfer within each platform
how_its_made: Because we never actually finished the project, there is not much to share here. We were planning to use an archive node to fetch historical data from various L2 contracts (and storing it in a database since archive node data is expensive). Then we would use the libraries and SDKs provided by the various L2 providers to fetch balance information and execute deposits, withdrawals, and transfers.
